content_zh:
就在这帮人一愣之际，林铮也出手了！林铮两步冲上前，一击践踏落下，两名法师头上马上飘起了300多的伤害，挥起匕首一划，-346点血，“呃！”，一名法师闷哼一声喉咙带着一道血痕倒地！
“狗屎！”一名火枪手见状，大骂一声，举起左轮枪便向林铮开火。“砰砰砰！”林铮咬下一个面包，迎着子弹给了另一名法师一下将其了结，而后冲向了开火的火枪手！这时候，傲剑的战士已经回过头来，准备前后夹击林铮二人！可惜他们居然把有希三个女生忽略了，后果也就悲剧了！
一阵“滋啦！”的电击声响起，却是有希扔了个连环闪电，一时间好几个战士给电得嗷嗷叫！头上飘起了近400的伤害。
“擦！你们几个过去，把那三个娘们解决了！”一名重剑骑士指挥道，他叫傲剑无风，看起来似乎是这伙人的头领，杨琪发现了这一点，便想将这家伙解决了，到时候群龙无首，情况会好很多！看到杨琪提着黑鸦剑冲了上来，傲剑无风轻蔑地一笑，大声喝道：“全都不要出手，让我来会会这个天榜第三的高手！嘿嘿！想不到红尘烟雨还是个大美女！过来让本大爷爽一下吧！”
“你一定会很爽的！”看着傲剑无风那猥琐的样子，杨琪笑了，群殴她可能还会有所顾忌，这家伙居然要来和她单挑！看着傲剑无风蛇形冲来，杨琪一乐，“呵！想拼操作吗？姑奶奶我奉陪！”傲剑无风十分熟练地双手握剑迎向了杨琪，狠狠地一剑刺去，正是对准了杨琪的喉咙，出手时机和攻击位置都把握得非常好，换做个普通的玩家这一击是只能硬接下来了，但杨琪早在他提剑的时候已经做好了闪避的预备动作，右脚离地一转，傲剑无风“呼！”地贴着林铮穿了过去，一个大大的miss十分给力地漂亮起来，而杨琪也很不客气地朝傲剑无风的小腿一踢，啪！的一下，傲剑无风便半跪到地上，还掉了100多的血。
仅仅一个照面，傲剑无风居然就被踢倒，有些让傲剑的玩家始料不及，原本还以为他们会对砍上几十刀最后来个惨胜结束，那样才有高手的范！这要是杨琪知道的话，一定会笑掉大牙，他傲剑无风算什么高手啊！不过就是级数高了一点而已，操作什么的只能算勉强过关，就像刚才那次攻击，明显是冲过头了！不然也不会被杨琪一脚踢倒地，真正的高手可不会犯这种低级错误！而他最大的错误就是高估了自己而低估了杨琪，错误的结果就是杨琪两剑劈下，将他劈死在地。
“擦！这娘们干掉了风哥，弟兄们上，给风哥报仇！操翻她！”说完，一票的战士都杀来了，一名甲士最先冲到杨琪面前，杨琪冷笑一下，“巨剑刺击！”黑鸦剑发出剑气形成一把巨剑，见状，一名重剑骑士马上大喊：“快退！小心被震退了！”巨剑刺击，一级是造成150%的物理伤害并将对手震退，傲剑的甲士直愣愣地就撞上了杨琪的刺击，“砰！——”一声气爆，甲士给一下击飞，而他身后的玩家尽管有所准备，但还是有好几个被甲士撞倒在地。
“啊！”另一边，攻击林铮的火枪手被林铮堵住了，一击下段踢将火枪手的移动速度大幅降低了，跑也跑不掉的火枪手面对攻击凶悍的林铮，表示抵抗不能，两下被杀！
“都聚一块！齐射！射死他丫的！”在这声叫唤下，傲剑的法师和射手们快速地聚集到一起，“擦！”林铮低骂一声，眼见对面法师都开始引导连环闪电了，马上闪到一棵树后面，失去目标的法师魔法的引导也停下来了，“妈的！这视角卡得也太快了！”一名法师破口骂道。
“冲上去，我看他往哪里跑！”
“对！冲上去！”
听着杂乱的奔跑声，树后面的林铮深深地吸了口气，拿出一个面包咬下，瞬间冲了出去，匕首脱手而去，准确地命中了一名法师的喉咙，吓得所有人马上停下了！
“攻击！”反应过来的一名火枪手大喊，瞬间便又有几个反应过来的开始射击，顿时林铮的血哗啦啦地死命掉着，这时一道治疗光芒落到了林铮身上，居然出现了暴击效果，瞬间给林铮加了近1000的血，林铮又吃了一个甘露丸，几乎都满血了！感觉倍棒的林铮冲到了攻击队伍面前，血量还有一半多，一击“践踏！”蓄力加1，反手给了一名法师一刀，累计上之前的蓄力点，已经达到5个蓄力点了！视野里，“炸裂！”的技能键已经亮了起来，林铮毫不犹豫地怒吼一声，狠狠地一脚践踏地面！“炸裂！”

content_en:
Just when this group of people was stunned, Lin Zheng also took action! Lin Zheng rushed forward in two steps and trampled down the two mages. More than 300 damage was immediately dealt to the heads of the two mages. He swung the dagger and slashed -346 points of blood. "Ugh!", a mage groaned and fell to the ground with a blood stain in his throat!
"Shit!" Upon seeing this, a musketeer yelled, raised his revolver and opened fire at Lin Zheng. "Bang, bang, bang!" Lin Zheng bit off a piece of bread, faced the bullet and hit the other mage to kill him, and then rushed towards the musketeer who fired! At this time, Aojian's warriors had turned back, preparing to attack Lin Zheng and Lin Zheng from both sides! It's a pity that they ignored the three girls Yuxi, and the consequences were tragic!
There was an electric shock sound of "Hi!", but Yuxi threw a chain of lightning, and several soldiers were electrocuted and screamed for a while! Nearly 400 injuries were floating over his head.
"Crap! You guys go over and get rid of those three girls!" A heavy sword knight commanded, his name is Aojian Wufeng, he seems to be the leader of this group of people. When Yang Qi discovered this, he wanted to get rid of this guy. By then, there will be no leader, and the situation will be much better! Seeing Yang Qi rushing up with the Black Crow Sword, Aojian Wufeng smiled contemptuously and shouted loudly: "Don't take action at all, let me meet this master who is the third in the ranking! Hehe! I didn't expect that Hongchen Yanyu is still a beautiful woman! Come over and let me have fun!"
"You will definitely be very happy!" Looking at Ao Jian Wufeng's wretched look, Yang Qi smiled. She might still have scruples about a group fight, but this guy actually wants to challenge her in a one-on-one fight! Seeing Aojian Wufeng rushing towards him like a snake, Yang Qi was delighted, "Ha! Do you want to fight for the operation? Auntie, I'll accompany you!" Aojian Wufeng held the sword with both hands very skillfully and faced Yang Qi. He stabbed fiercely with the sword, aiming at Yang Qi's throat. He grasped the timing and position of the attack very well. If it were an ordinary player, this blow He had no choice but to force it, but Yang Qi had already made preparations to dodge when he raised the sword. He turned his right foot off the ground, and Ao Jian Wu Feng passed through Lin Zheng with a "Whoop!", a big miss that was very powerful and beautiful, and Yang Qi also kicked Ao Jian Wu Feng's calf very rudely, bang! With a click, Aojian Wufeng half-knelt on the ground and lost more than 100 blood.
In just one encounter, Aojian Wufeng was kicked down, which surprised the players of Aojian. They originally thought that they would be hacked dozens of times and end up with a tragic victory. Only in that way can they be like a master! If Yang Qi knew this, he would definitely laugh out loud. What kind of master is he, Ao Jian Wu Feng! It's just that the level is a little higher, and the operations can only be considered as barely passing. Just like the attack just now, it was obviously too much! Otherwise, he wouldn't have been kicked to the ground by Yang Qi. A real master would not make such a low-level mistake! His biggest mistake was to overestimate himself and underestimate Yang Qi. The result of his mistake was that Yang Qi slashed him to the ground with two swords.
"Shit! This bitch killed Brother Feng, brothers, come on, avenge Brother Feng! Fuck her!" After saying that, all the soldiers came to kill, and a soldier rushed to Yang Qi first. Yang Qi sneered, "Strike with the giant sword!" The Black Crow Sword emitted sword energy to form a giant sword. Seeing this, an epee knight immediately shouted: "Quickly retreat! Be careful to be knocked back! "The giant sword stabbing, the first level is to cause 150% physical damage and knock back the opponent. The proud swordsman suddenly bumped into Yang Qi's stabbing, "Bang!" With a burst of air, the soldier was knocked away, and although the players behind him were prepared, several of them were knocked to the ground.
"Ah!" On the other side, the musketeer who attacked Lin Zheng was blocked by Lin Zheng. A downward kick greatly reduced the musketeer's movement speed. The musketeer who could not run away faced Lin Zheng who was attacking fiercely. He expressed that he could not resist and was killed in two blows.!
"Get together! Volley! Shoot him to death!" At this call, the mages and shooters of Ao Jian quickly gathered together, "Oh!" Lin Zheng cursed lowly. Seeing that the mages on the opposite side began to guide the chain lightning, he immediately ducked behind a tree, and the guidance of the magic of the mage who lost the target also stopped, "Damn! This perspective is stuck too fast!" A mage cursed.
"Rush forward and let's see where he goes!"
"Yes! Charge forward!"
Listening to the chaotic running sounds, Lin Zheng behind the tree took a deep breath, took out a piece of bread, bit it, and rushed out in an instant. The dagger flew away and accurately hit a mage in the throat, scaring everyone to stop immediately!
"Attack!" A musketeer who reacted shouted, and in an instant, several more reacted and started shooting. Lin Zheng's blood was dripping. At this time, a healing light fell on Lin Zheng. It actually had a critical hit effect. It instantly added nearly 1,000 blood to Lin Zheng. Lin Zheng took another nectar pill, and his health was almost full! Feeling doubly powerful, Lin Zheng rushed in front of the attacking team. He still had more than half of his health. He hit "Trample!" to increase the charge by 1. He gave a mage a knife with his backhand. After adding the previous charge points, he had reached 5 charge points! In the field of vision, the "Explode!" skill button had already lit up. Lin Zheng roared without hesitation and trampled the ground with his foot! "Explode!"
